title: Trump UFO Advisory Team Pushes Defence Firms to Disclose Secret Alien Tech
description: Trump's UFO advisory team is openly pressuring US defence giants like Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman to reveal any secret alien tech and join the president's latest UAP disclosure push.

title: Harvard professor with polarizing alien theories is picked to lead new White House UFO council
description: WASHINGTON — A polarizing Harvard astronomer known for splashy theories about alien visits has been tapped by the White House to lead a team of outside scientists to study the national security risks posed by UFOs.
